# Minimalist Toolkit

Minimalist Toolkit is a web workspace that combines six focused productivity tools under one account.

## Public pages
- / : Product overview, workflow showcase, use cases, security and FAQ
- /login : Sign in
- /signup : Create an account
- /forgot-password : Account recovery guidance

## Workspace tools (after sign-in)
- /app/dashboard : Workspace overview and analytics
- /app/snippets : Save, search, and organize reusable code
- /app/categories : Browse snippet categories and their distribution
- /app/mockify : Generate visual mockups from text prompts
- /app/promptcraft : Draft and improve prompts for a specific model
- /app/quotes : Client quotes and invoices, convertible from quote to invoice
- /app/prioritizer : Weighted feature scoring with rank fragility analysis
- /app/chat : AI chat for quick help
- /app/profile : Account overview and library stats
- /app/settings : Account, appearance, privacy and tool preferences

## Notes
- Each tool has its own workflow and page.
- Snippets, Quotes and Prioritizer are deterministic and work without an AI key.
- Mockify, PromptCraft and AI Chat depend on the relevant server configuration.
- User workspace data is private to the signed-in account, enforced by database row-level security.

Made by Tanveer: https://muhammadtanveerabbas.vercel.app
